description: Implementation of SHA-1 cryptographic hash function, including core functions, update, finish, file hashing, HMAC, and self-test routines.

methods.name: sha1_starts
methods.description: Initializes SHA-1 context with initial hash values and zeroed counters.

methods.name: sha1_process
methods.description: Processes a 64-byte block of data, updating the hash state.

methods.name: sha1_update
methods.description: Updates the hash with new data, handling buffering and multiple blocks.

methods.name: sha1_finish
methods.description: Finalizes the hash computation, producing the digest.

methods.name: sha1_file
methods.description: Computes SHA-1 hash of a file's contents.

methods.name: sha1_csum
methods.description: Computes SHA-1 hash of a buffer.

methods.name: sha1_hmac
methods.description: Computes HMAC using SHA-1 with a given key and buffer.

methods.name: sha1_self_test
methods.description: Performs self-test to verify SHA-1 implementation correctness.
